text:
Type: extendable dining table with turned legs
Use: dining, hosting guests; dining room, kitchen
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted solid wood frame, painted wood-based top, turned solid wood legs
Colors: off-white, warm cream white
Shape: rectangular top with a slim lip edge and apron, four tapered turned legs with carved collars, graceful, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, soft, homey, timeless
Goes with: white or pale wood chairs, light grey walls, linen textiles; country kitchens, classic or farmhouse dining rooms
